svg.title: One-piece and two-piece RF shields
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, side views of a 1.6 mm board. Left: a one-piece shield, a closed metal can soldered over small parts, which hides them from inspection once it is on. Right: a two-piece shield: an open frame soldered with the other parts, so the parts inside can still be inspected, and a lid pressed on at the end.

g.text: Two-piece: up to a few hundred
Hides the parts under it once fitted
Shield clips work like a two-piece shield (PCB-DFA-050).
